qe: The Pashupata sect of Shaivism, which had followers in Bihar, was founded by which teacher?
qh: शैव धर्म का पाशुपत संप्रदाय, जिसके अनुयायी बिहार में भी थे, किस आचार्य द्वारा स्थापित माना जाता है?
e: Shaiv mat ke ek pramukh sampraday 'Pashupata' sampraday ki sthapna parampara ke anusar Lakulisha naam ke acharya ne ki tatha unke naam par 'Lakulisha' ki murtiyan bhi banti rahi. 'Bihar Through the Ages' ke anusar Bihar me bhi is sampraday ke anuyayi the; Narayanapala ke Bhagalpur plate (tamba-patra abhilekh) me Pashupata sampraday ka zikr milta hai tatha Chotanagpur ke kshetra (Benisagar) ki khudai me Lakulisha ki murti bhi mili hai. Lakulisha ke anuyayi apne shareer par vibhuti/bhasm lagate the tatha Shivling ki puja tatha tapasya par zor dete the; Shaiv mat ke saath-saath Shakti (Devi) tatha Vaishnav mat bhi Bihar me lokpriya the. Shankaracharya ne Advait Vedant ka prachar kiya, Ramanuja ne Vishishtadvait tatha Basava ne Lingayat mat ka - isliye sahi uttar Lakulisha hai. Exam point: Pashupata sampraday ke sansthapak = Lakulisha; Bihar me iska pramaan Narayanapala ke Bhagalpur plate (tamba-patra) tatha Singhbhum (Benisagar) me mili Lakulisha ki murti se milta hai.

qe: Sapta-matrika images found in Bihar represent the worship of which group of deities?
qh: बिहार में मिली सप्त-मातृका प्रतिमाएँ किस देवी-समूह की पूजा को दर्शाती हैं?
e: Sapta-matrika ka arth hai saat matrikayein yaani saat deviyan; inhe saat pramukh devtaon ki shaktiyan maana jaata hai tatha prachin kaal me Bihar tatha anya kshetraon me inki puja ka prachalan tha. 'Bihar Through the Ages' ke anusar Bihar me Ganesh, Kartikeya (Skanda) tatha Devi (Durga/Uma) ki anek murtiyan mili hain tatha 'Mahishamardini' (mahishasur ka vadh karti Durga) ki bhi anek pratimayein prapt hui hain; yeh sab Shakti tatha Saiv upasana ke lokpriya hone ke pramaan hain. Devi ki puja me maa ke aage bali tatha vishesh sanskar ki parampara bhi milti hai, jise baad me sanyam tatha saumya puja ke roop me badalne ki koshish hui. Sapta rishi, saat nadiyan tatha saat grah alag avdharnayein hain - isliye sahi uttar saat matri-deviyan hain. Exam point: Sapta-matrika = saat matri deviyan, jo saat devtaon ki shaktiyan maani jaati hain; Bihar me Mahishamardini tatha Devi ki anek pratimayein mili hain, jo Shakti upasana ke pramaan hain.

qe: The Vishnupada temple of Gaya is known because inside it there is a preserved footprint of which deity?
qh: गया का विष्णुपद मंदिर किस देवता के संरक्षित चरण-चिह्न के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Gaya ka Vishnupada mandir us sthal par bana hai jahan parampara ke anusar Bhagwan Vishnu ka charan-chinh (pairon ka nishaan) patthar par aankit hai; yahi mandir Vishnu ki upasana ka bada kendra raha tatha aaj bhi yatree yahan pind-daan tatha shraddh ke liye aate hain. 'Bihar Through the Ages' ke anusar is mandir ke prangan se mila ek abhilekh Narayanapala ke saatvein rajya-varsh ka hai tatha usme 'Purushottama' yaani Vishnu ka dhyaan kiya gaya hai; mandir ke neeche ki slab par Vashudev (Vishnu) ki stuti wala abhilekh bhi mila jo Govindapala ke samay ka maana jaata hai. Isi kshetra me Anantasayi Vishnu ki murti bhi hai jisme Vishnu Lakshmi ki god me apne charan rakhe dikhte hain; yeh sab pramaan dikhate hain ki Gaya kshetra me Vishnu-bhakti poori tarah jami hui thi. Shiv, Surya tatha Ganesh ki bhi murtiyan Bihar me mili hain, lekin Vishnupada mandir ka charan-chinh Vishnu ka hai - isliye sahi uttar Vishnu hai. Exam point: Vishnupada mandir (Gaya) = Vishnu ke charan-chinh wala mandir, Pitrapaksha me pind-daan ka kendra; mandir ke abhilekh Pala shasak Narayanapala tatha Govindapala ke samay ke hain.

qe: The famous hoard of Pala-period bronze images, including that of Balarama, was discovered at which site in Gaya district?
qh: पाल कालीन कांस्य मूर्तियों का प्रसिद्ध कोष, जिसमें बलराम की मूर्ति भी शामिल है, गया जिले के किस स्थल से मिला?
e: Kurkihar Gaya jile ka woh sthal hai jahan se Pala kaal ki kansya (bronze) murtiyon ka bada bhandar mila; inme Balarama yaani Haladhar (Vishnu ka satva avtar maana jane wala) ki murtiyan bhi shaamil hain, jo aaj kai sangrahalayon me rakhi hain. Pala shasak kala ke bade sanrakshak the; unke samay me patthar, kansya tatha mitti ki murtiyon me Vishnu, Shiv, Devi, Buddha tatha Bodhisattva ki aakritiyan banai gayi tatha Nalanda tatha Vikramshila ke mahaviharon se in murtiyon ko desh-videsh bhejne ka kaam bhi hota tha, isliye Pala kala desh ke bahar bhi pahunchi. Kurkihar ki murtiyon me tin ke saath-saath sone-chandi ke patle aavaran bhi dikhte hain, jo us samay ki dhatu-shilp ki uchch kaushal ko dikhate hain. Konch tatha Ramgaya kshetra se bhi Vishnu tatha avtar sambandhi avashesh mile hain, lekin kansya murtiyon ka prasiddh bhandar Kurkihar ka hi hai - isliye sahi uttar Kurkihar hai. Exam point: Kurkihar (Gaya jila) = Pala kaal ki kansya murtiyon ka prasiddh bhandar, jisme Balarama ki murtiyan bhi; Pala kala Nalanda-Vikramshila ke madhyam se videsh tak pahunchi.

qe: The Tibetan scholar Dharmaswami, who visited Bihar in 1232-34, noted that out of about eighty Buddhist monasteries how many were still in a serviceable condition?
qh: तिब्बती विद्वान धर्मस्वामी ने, जिन्होंने 1232-34 में बिहार का भ्रमण किया, बताया कि लगभग अस्सी बौद्ध विहारों में से कितने अभी उपयोग-योग्य थे?
e: 1232 se 1234 ke beech tibbati vidwan Dharmaswami ne Bihar ka bhraman kiya tatha apne vivaran me likha ki yahan Brahmanical (Vishnu-Shiv-Devi ki puja karne wale) upasak bahusankhyak the jabki Bauddh log alp-sankhyak the. Unhone bataya ki lagbhag 80 Bauddh viharon me se sirf do hi theek halat me kaam-laayak bache the - yahi baat dikhati hai ki Pala shasan ke ant tak Nalanda-Vikramshila jaisi sansthaon ki chamak ke baad 13vein sadi me Bauddh dharm ka prabhav bahut ghat gaya tha. Unhone yah bhi likha ki Bodh Gaya (Vajrasana) ke bikhshuon ne Buddha ki murti ko non-Buddhist hamlon se bachane ke liye uske saamne Shiv ki murti laga di thi. Aise vivaran isliye mahatvapurn hain kyunki videshi yatri ke aankhon-dekhe varnan se hum us daur ki dharmik sthiti samajh paate hain. Isliye sahi uttar 'keval do' hai. Exam point: Dharmaswami (tibbati vidwan, 1232-34) ke anusar lagbhag 80 Bauddh viharon me se sirf 2 kaam-laayak bache the; unke samay Brahmanical upasak bahusankhyak tatha Bauddh alp-sankhyak the; Bodh Gaya me Shiv ki murti Buddha ki murti ke aage rakhne ka ullekh bhi unhone kiya.

qe: According to 'Bihar Through the Ages', the bronze image of the Buddha found at Sultanganj in Bhagalpur district is now kept in a museum of which country?
qh: 'बिहार थ्रू द एजेज' के अनुसार भागलपुर जिले के सुल्तानगंज से मिली बुद्ध की कांस्य प्रतिमा अब किस देश के संग्रहालय में रखी है?
e: Sultanganj (Bhagalpur jila) me Ganga kinare khudai ke dauran Buddha ki ek vishal kansya (bronze) murti mili; yah lagbhag saade do meter unchi hai tatha ise Gupta kaal ki dhatu-murti-kala ka uttam namuna maana jaata hai, kyunki iske rang-roop tatha bhav-bhangima achhe se bachi hui hai. Yeh murti baad me Britain le jai gayi tatha aaj wahan ke Birmingham Museum me rakhi hai; isi tarah Pala kaal ki kai kansya murtiyan Nepal, Tibet tatha anya deshon ke sangrahalayon me bhi pahunchi, kyunki unke grahak yatree tatha Raja the. Aisi murtiyon ka Bihar se bahar jaana yah dikhata hai ki prachin Bihar ki kala desh ki seema se bhi aage prasiddh thi tatha uski maang rahi. France, Japan tatha Thailand ke sangrahalayon me bhi Bharatiya kala hai, lekin Sultanganj ki Buddha pratima ke liye sahi uttar Britain hai. Exam point: Sultanganj (Bhagalpur) ki kansya Buddha murti = Gupta kaal ki dhatu-kala ka uttam namuna, aaj Britain ke Birmingham Museum me; Pala kaal ki murtiyan Tibet-Nepal tatha anya deshon me bhi pahunchi.

qe: The Mundeshwari Devi temple, described in 'Bihar Through the Ages' as a very old surviving temple, is located in which district of Bihar?
qh: 'बिहार थ्रू द एजेज' में वर्णित अत्यंत प्राचीन जीवित मंदिर मुंडेश्वरी देवी मंदिर बिहार के किस जिले में स्थित है?
e: Mundeshwari Devi mandir Kaimur jile me Ramgarh (Chainpur) pahadi par sthit hai tatha ise bharat ke sabse purane kaam karte hue mandiron me ginta jaata hai; iski sthapna-parampara bahut prachin maani jaati hai tatha mandir me Devi ki murti ke saath Shiv tatha anya devtaon ki pratimayein bhi hain. 'Bihar Through the Ages' ki chitra-soochi me is mandir ka zikr hai, jisse pata chalta hai ki yah kshetra Pala-Pratihar kaal me dharmik tatha kalatmak roop se sakriya tha. Isi jile me Mundeshwari ke alawa Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuary tatha isi jile me Kaimur van-kshetra tatha Adhaura-Bhabhua ke jangal bhi hain, isliye Kaimur dharmik tatha prakritik dono drishti se mahatvapurn hai. Nalanda (Mahavihara), Gaya (Bodh Gaya) tatha Rohtas (Rohtasgarh kila) bhi bade kendra hain, lekin Mundeshwari Devi mandir Kaimur me hai - isliye sahi uttar Kaimur hai. Exam point: Mundeshwari Devi mandir = Kaimur jila (Ramgarh/Chainpur pahadi), bharat ke sabse purane kaam karte mandiron me ginta jaata hai; Kaimur jila Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuary ke liye bhi jaana jaata hai.

qe: The mausoleums of Malik Ibrahim Baya at Bihar Sharif and of Shah Daulat at Maner belong to which architectural tradition?
qh: बिहार शरीफ में मलिक इब्राहिम बाया तथा मनेर में शाह दौलत की मजारें किस स्थापत्य परंपरा से संबंधित हैं?
oe: Indo-Islamic tomb architecture of medieval Bihar
oh: मध्यकालीन बिहार की इंडो-इस्लामिक मकबरा-स्थापत्य परंपरा
e: Bihar Sharif me Malik Ibrahim Baya ki mazar tatha Maner me Shah Daulat ki mazar madhyakaleen Bihar ke sufi-sthapatya ke prasiddh namune hain; in mazaron par gumbad, mehrab-dar darwaze tatha sajavat ke liye rangin tile-kaari dekhne ko milti hai, isliye yah Indo-Islamic tomb architecture ke udaharan kehlate hain. Maner tatha Bihar Sharif dono sufi kshetra the: Maner me Shah Daulat ki dargah tatha Bihar Sharif me Makhdum Sharfuddin Yahiya Maneri (Makhdoom-ul-Mulk) ka asthana tha, isliye yahan dharmik tatha sanskritik gatividhiyan chalti thi tatha alim aur kavi aate-jaate the. Aise kshetron ke aas-paas bazaar, khanqah tatha madarse bhi base, isliye shahar ka vikas hua. Bauddh stupa, Nagara mandir tatha colonial architecture alag paramparaen hain - isliye sahi uttar Indo-Islamic mazara-sthapatya hai. Exam point: Malik Ibrahim Baya ki mazar (Bihar Sharif) tatha Shah Daulat ki mazar (Maner) = Indo-Islamic tomb architecture; dono kshetra sufi parampara ke kendra, jahan dargah, khanqah tatha bazaar ek saath base.

qe: In which holy city of Bihar, according to 'Bihar Through the Ages', did Buddhist monks place a Shiva image in front of the Buddha image to protect it?
qh: 'बिहार थ्रू द एजेज' के अनुसार बिहार के किस पवित्र स्थल पर बौद्ध भिक्षुओं ने बुद्ध की मूर्ति की रक्षा के लिए उसके सामने शिव की मूर्ति लगाई थी?
e: Tibbati vidwan Dharmaswami ne 1232-34 ke apne bhraman-vivaran me likha ki Bodh Gaya (Vajrasana) ke bikhshuon ne Buddha ki murti ko non-Buddhist hamlon se bachane ke liye uske saamne Shiv ki murti laga di thi, taaki hamlavar samjhein ki yahan Shiv ki puja hoti hai tatha murti ko chhod dein. Yah ghatna us daur ki sthiti dikhati hai jab Bauddh dharm ka prabhav kam ho gaya tha tatha Brahmanical tatha Tantrik upasana bahusankhyak ho gayi thi; usi samay Magadha me Tantrik matri-devi ke liye 300 bhainson tatha 300 bojh dhan ki bali dene ka bhi zikr milta hai. Aise varnan videshi yatri ke prayan se milte hain, isliye woh aitihasik pramaan ke roop me bahut upyogi hote hain. Rajgir, Nalanda tatha Vaishali bhi Bauddh itihas ke bade kendra hain, lekin Shiv ki murti Buddha ki murti ke aage rakhne ka ullekh Bodh Gaya ke liye hai - isliye sahi uttar Bodh Gaya hai. Exam point: Bodh Gaya ke bikhshuon dwara Buddha murti ke aage Shiv murti rakhne ka ullekh tibbati vidwan Dharmaswami (1232-34) ke vivaran me milta hai; us daur me Bauddh dharm ka prabhav ghat chuka tha tatha Brahmanical-Tantrik upasana bahusankhyak thi.
